## par-p07-v07 — argument map

Śiva-tattva: will-knowledge-action-formed pure-full-bliss, throbbing full-I-joy in all knowers, bearing lakh-fold reflections. First throb (will-to-emit taken): will-power-tattva — freedom's greatness, outward-bloom-wish, bliss-surplus, 'I' grasped. Dimming ladder: just-sprouting world I-covered (sadāśiva, will-chief, faint this) → sprouted world I-wrapped (īśvara, knowing-chief, clarified this) → I-this oneness (śuddhavidyā, doing-chief); single variable: this-portion faintness. Māyā: difference-spreading among own-natured things, hardest feat, knower-pride in void, material cause of art-to-earth. Person/bondsman: Lord veiling own-form by māyā-power (freedom's synonym), contracted-knowerness; deemed chains; wandering (body through ages, intellect across births). Magician immunity: nondifferent, yet His delusion never the Lord's — self-willed illusion. Freed (ciddhana): recognition-brought sovereignty, body-world as pure feeling, freed-bodied, Śiva at fall. Five glories → five littles on robbed-king terms (respective pairing).

### Open
- dhyāmala/adhyāmala grading literal; śāstra-internal check welcome.
- Two-phase release (freed-bodied vs Śiva-at-fall) both kept.
- Glory→sheath respective pairing (kalā←doership etc.) standard doctrine.
